title: Strong yet ductile refractory high entropy alloy fabricated via additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by laser engineered net shaping with coaxial powder feeding in argon atmosphere. Parameters: 550W laser power (building), 800W (remelting), 5mm/s scanning speed, 381µm hatching space, 200µm layer thickness. Post-process vacuum annealing at 1273K for 4h.

title: Strong yet ductile refractory high entropy alloy fabricated via additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by arc melting pure elemental nuggets in argon atmosphere, remelted 10 times, cast into water-cooled copper mould.
